messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-4926 fired for service=redwood-inference-eu (5xx spike) — page to oncall escalation chain. https://pd.example/INC-4926
alex: acked — looking now. seeing 5xx across embed-workers-prod-eu :eyes:
pagerduty-bot: Auto-ack by oncall_rotation (jamal) — incident assigned to the rotation temporarily
jamal: I saw the page and acked but i'm mid-incident on another alert, can someone take primary?
maria: I can jump in for triage, grabbing logs+kibana. alex, want me to start correlation across pods?
alex: pls do. i'll try to claim ownership in PD and start mitigation. jamal — thx for the ack.
alex: /pagerduty assign INC-4926 alex  (running to transfer ownership)
andre: quick Q — is this KV-cache returning 503s or are upstream model servers OOMing? logs looked mixed earlier.
maria: logs: lots of `model-infer-worker` 503s with "KVCache timeout" and also a spike of OOM kills on node gpu-12. pasted short tail:
```
2026-02-14T09:12:03Z model-infer-worker-3 ERROR request failed 503 "KVCache timeout"
2026-02-14T09:12:07Z kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4123 (python)
```
alex: thanks. hypothesis: autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough after traffic surge; combined with kvcache contention causing retries -> overload -> OOM. plan: 1) pin traffic to fallback model-variant-smaller-batch 2) scale dedicated pool + restart poisoned pods 3) turn on KV cache rate-limit.
jamal: tagging customer-alert-runbook and setting impact: "customer-facing latency increase and 5xx for embeddings-producing endpoints" — prob impact window now ~4m. recommend high-priority comms if >10m.
alex: actioning 1 now: routing flag to fallback variant (will post command).
andre: if you need a quick workaround, reduce global batch_size to 8 for the variant and enable prefix-cache-only mode. lower QPS per request.
alex: executing route swap: `curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/swap -d '{"service":"embeddings","to":"model-variant-smaller-batch"}'` — response 202.
maria: restarting 3 pods on node gpu-12 that reported OOMs (kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-infer-worker -n prod --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-12)
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4926 assigned to alex via manual transfer
alex: confirmed ownership in PD. I'll be primary. jamal — thanks for the ephemeral ack. please stand by for any followups.
andre: scaling dedicated pool by +2 nodes (requested via infra autoscale job). ETA ~60s to 2m.
alex: noticing error rate dropping in the last 30s by ~40% per metrics. tailing logs to confirm KV timeouts decreasing.
maria: KV cache rate-limit toggle applied (configs pushed). seeing fewer retry storms.
alex: interim status update for thread: owning (alex), mitigation applied: route-swap + pod restarts + pool scale + kv rate-limit. customer impact: degraded embeddings for ~4–11 minutes, ~20% of requests got 5xx at peak, mitigated now.
jamal: added note to incident doc, linking runbook + postmortem stub: https://wiki/incident/INC-4926
alex: will keep monitoring for 15m then close PD if stable. if any customer escalations come in, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Reminder: please add the severity tag and fill 'customer impact' field in PD form before close.
alex: done — filled impact, severity=high, mitigation steps in comments. marking next check at +15m.
andre: heads-up: create follow-up action to improve autoscaler cold-start policy for EU dedicated pools (added as todo in incident doc).
alex: agreed. thanks all. closing thread in 15m if green.
